what.text: This page follows refugees from Montenegro in all host countries, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 696 Montenegrin refugees, and France hosted 31.6% of them.
After France, the largest hosts are Germany, Denmark and the United States.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Montenegro, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2009 to 2012.

when.text: UNHCR's series starts in 2006 at 136 refugees, and the figure was at its highest, 4052, at the end of 2012.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took.
These are year-end totals summed over every host country that reported to UNHCR.
